description: List blocked time on staff calendars at one location (breaks, meetings, personal time). GraphQL: timeblocks.

after.description: Cursor: pageInfo.endCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Boulevard filter expression (QueryString) over: staffId, startAt, cancelled. Comparisons joined with AND/OR, strings in single quotes, ISO 8601 datetimes, e.g. "startAt >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND cancelled = false". Field names are case sensitive.

name: boulevard_list_timeblocks
title: List timeblocks
